skills.title: Deep Research
skills.summary: Research questions, evidence discovery, literature synthesis, fact-checking, and research reports.
intents: investigate a research question
synthesize scholarly evidence
verify claims
design a systematic review

routes.title: Full research
intents: complete evidence-grounded research report

routes.title: Quick research brief
intents: short research brief with key sources

routes.title: Research text review
intents: review an existing research text or report

routes.title: Evidence literature review
intents: search and synthesize literature on a topic

routes.title: WHY/HOW/WHAT scan
intents: rapidly compare a focused paper shortlist

routes.title: Claim fact-check
intents: verify specific factual or scholarly claims

routes.title: Socratic research planning
intents: clarify a vague research idea through guided dialogue

routes.title: Systematic review
intents: conduct a PRISMA systematic review or meta-analysis

near_misses.intent: write a literature-review section for a manuscript
near_misses.reason: The deliverable is manuscript prose rather than an evidence synthesis artifact.
Manuscript peer review belongs to the reviewer Skill, not research-text review.
A cross-stage deliverable needs the pipeline rather than a standalone research route.

skills.title: Academic Paper
skills.summary: Academic manuscript planning, drafting, revision, citation work, disclosure, and format conversion.
intents: plan or draft an academic paper
revise a manuscript
prepare citation or submission outputs
respond to reviewer feedback

routes.title: Full manuscript drafting
intents: draft a complete paper from existing research materials

routes.title: Outline only
intents: create a detailed manuscript outline and evidence map

routes.title: Manuscript revision
intents: revise a draft against reviewer feedback

routes.title: Abstract only
intents: write an abstract and keywords for an existing manuscript

routes.title: Manuscript literature review
intents: prepare literature-review material or prose for a manuscript

routes.title: Format conversion
intents: convert a final draft to a submission format

routes.title: Citation check
intents: audit citations and references in a draft

routes.title: Guided paper planning
intents: plan a paper through structured dialogue

routes.title: Revision coaching
intents: parse reviewer comments and develop a revision strategy

routes.title: AI disclosure
intents: prepare a venue-specific AI-use disclosure

routes.title: Rebuttal audit
intents: audit an existing rebuttal against reviewer comments

near_misses.intent: start from a topic and continue through review and finalization
near_misses.reason: From-scratch cross-stage work needs pipeline coordination and Gates.
Systematic-review methodology is research work, not manuscript literature-section drafting.
Independent manuscript assessment belongs to the reviewer Skill.

skills.title: Academic Paper Reviewer
skills.summary: Independent manuscript peer review, focused methodology assessment, guided review, and revision verification.
intents: peer-review an academic manuscript
verify a revised manuscript
focus on methodology
calibrate reviewer judgments

routes.title: Full peer review
intents: run a complete multi-perspective manuscript review

routes.title: Revision re-review
intents: verify whether a revised manuscript addresses prior review

routes.title: Quick review
intents: identify the most important manuscript issues quickly

routes.title: Methodology-focused review
intents: assess research design and methodology in depth

routes.title: Guided review
intents: work through manuscript issues through Socratic dialogue

routes.title: Reviewer calibration
intents: measure reviewer accuracy against a gold set

near_misses.intent: verify facts or claims in a research report
near_misses.reason: Claim verification is evidence research, not manuscript peer review.
Reviewer routes remain read-only with respect to manuscript content.
Rebuttal QA differs from verifying changes in the revised manuscript.

skills.title: Academic Pipeline
skills.summary: Cross-stage orchestration from research through writing, integrity, review, revision, and finalization.
intents: complete a research-to-publication workflow
continue a cross-stage paper workflow
enter the pipeline from existing materials

routes.title: End-to-end pipeline
intents: start from a research goal and continue to a submission package

routes.title: Mid-entry or resume
intents: continue the pipeline from research materials, a draft, or review feedback

near_misses.reason: A standalone research route avoids unnecessary pipeline overhead.
A single writing deliverable can go directly to the paper Skill.
A local peer-review request does not require pipeline orchestration.
